note: When more than one Lean module can match a clause, only the canonical module may produce evidence for that normative unit. This prevents double-counting and prevents a less faithful model from overwriting a more faithful one.

rationale.InterestSplitRate5Pct: local tax art.71_6(1) prescribes an exact 5/100 rate with no rounding rule; this model keeps numerator and denominator separate and imports no floor/ceiling. LocalInterestTaxRate5 applies Nat division (floor), which imports an unstated rounding rule, so it must not produce evidence for this unit.
